titleText: JTF News: BBC News, ABC News Australia
mainText: A plane and ground vehicle collided at LaGuardia Airport in New York, halting flights.
Iran stated it would close the Strait of Hormuz and target power plants in response to President Trump's ultimatum.

titleText: JTF News: CBC News, BBC News
mainText: President Trump stated that Immigration and Customs Enforcement agents will assist airport security during a Department of Homeland Security shutdown.
In the West Bank, Israeli settlers set fires to homes and assaulted Palestinians.

titleText: JTF News: The Guardian, BBC News
mainText: A drone attack on a hospital in Sudan killed 64 people during Eid, according to the World Health Organization.
